name: type-n-stitch
description: Text-based audio/video editing: transcribe, edit the words, render the cut.
author: Jonathan Yen <jonyen@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "cargo run -p server" "npm:dev -w client"
scripts.build: cargo build --release && npm run build -w client
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && eslint . && prettier --check .
